$comment: Known answers for home loan balance transfer, fetched and recomputed on 2026-10-10. EMI = P·r·(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), r = annual % ÷ 1200; interest left = EMI × months − outstanding. Published figures are rounded (₹ to the rupee, lakh to 2 decimals), so each case allows a small relative tolerance. Not used: Business Standard's ₹50 lakh example (its EMI difference 44,986 − 43,433 is printed as 1,533) and Outlook Money's interest saved (its outstanding after one year, ₹98,60,858, does not follow from its own ₹1 crore loan; only the new-loan side, which is computed from that outstanding, is used).
